consistency.reason: The five ratios share repeated arches, paper layers, offset shadows, white strips, dark ink, green emphasis, and orange warning branches. Horizontal, grid, stacked, wide parallel, and portrait arrangements are justified by their briefs. Pattern scale and occlusion vary substantially: compact seats show fragmented arches, whereas the large stacked cards show broad exposed arches. This is coherent but does not sustain equally controlled texture and spacing across every ratio.

character.reason: The defining arch geometry, overlapping patterned paper and label slips, and hard offset shadows are retained recognizably across the batch. Common Japanese sans typography and palette override the reference serif and reference colors as instructed; those substitutions are not counted as violations. Mostly upright cards, orthogonal connectors, and dense repeated label strips reduce the references' tilted-paper playfulness and fine flowing connectors. The batch retains its defining construction but does not consistently supply useful expressive variation deserving 4.

retainedTraits: Repeated arch-pattern geometry and contrasting inner arches.
Paper-card layering with visible offset shadows.

losses: Most paper groups appear more upright and regular than the reference collage.
Mostly straight or orthogonal arrows replace the fine organic merging curves.

batch.factualSummary: No required label omission, invented fact, or reversed route found in the five viewed captures.
batch.paletteAssessment: Visible roles align with the supplied light palette: dark ink/deep patterned papers, white surfaces, pale border-derived shadows, green emphasis/completion paths, and orange deficiency/damage warning paths. No pixel-exact palette conformance claim is made.

uncertainty.font: Noto Sans CJK JP is required by the briefs. The PNG glyphs are visually consistent with Japanese sans typography and show no visible missing-glyph boxes, but actual font selection or fallback cannot be proven from raster inspection alone; no font or source resources were read.
uncertainty.scale: Readability was judged on the original captures at their recorded pixel dimensions. Each frame exceeds its declared target artwork by 48 pixels in width and 96 in height, consistent with the recorded placement framing. The artwork was assessed within those frames; without reading placement metadata, CSS-to-device scale cannot be independently verified. No magnification or resampled image was used.
uncertainty.environmentInterruption: Manager reported environment replacement and unchanged initial captures. This review freshly opened both original references and all five permitted captures after that notice; no prior partial scores were reused.

scope: Only dispatch, named references, five initial PNG captures, associated briefs/checklists, and common palette were read. No conditions, prompts, run records, source, coordinator judgments, other runs, browser/network/git, or descendants used.
